author: Michael Bothager
html: Upon reading this, I tried do replicate it, and forgot to press the CTRL-key. Lo and behold, it works without the CTRL-key. So it is only SHIFT + double-click which hides the text.

author: Joshua Freislich
html:
it works on images as well, but the space remains "reserved". Try pressing ctrl+A to "select all" after an image is removed.

Oh, and this little gem is still a "hidden feature" of adblock. 03 August 2007!
